method: Candidate11 exact product validator logic, with test-only probe appended in a separate worktree; two retained normalized drafts and their original cited segment loaded from local private files. No model run or ASR replay.
preparation_note: The test itself passed. The first report writer did not recognize JSON object key ordering and failed to parse the test log; this report was produced from the already retained log without rerunning the test.
limits: Only the direct document validator and numeric/model guards were checked, not the complete generation pipeline, new model output, new recording or semantic acceptance.
Passing these checks does not prove that a future model generation will produce the same text or pass all post-validation checks.
All private audio, transcript, generated content and their hashes remain local.
